Question 1 of 5

Choose how your game should work.

How many target dummies should the training area include?
Single dummy
· Recommended

Only one target dummy is required; the request describes a single stationary target, not multiple opponents.

The request explicitly describes punching a single stationary target, so one dummy matches scope and keeps the loop focused.

Multiple dummies
Place 2-3 stationary dummies spaced around the spawn area so the player can move between targets and vary their punching practice.
Other

Keeping the proposed behavior is free. Scope changes require a paid planner edit within this project's existing spending cap. A failed edit keeps the previous proposal.
